correctness.rationale: Proof reduces the Jessen mean to an exact relative-phase maximum formula; unique phase alignment gives an explicitly positive Hessian with determinant product(amplitudes)/sum(amplitudes). Uniform even Taylor expansion gives the cap-volume constant; differentiation and the established weighted mean-count identity yield a beta integral and a relative O(epsilon) error. Exact rational Hessian identities and independent deterministic 2-/3-prime Jensen quadratures were run from the included checker. Limits are taken in the correct order and no finite test is used as an infinite proof.
